# Backspace Fork 1.16.7

## Juno: reliable live play and recovery

- Kept the last confirmed table and cards visible during temporary network or
  server failures instead of making the game disappear. Moves remain disabled
  until the view is synchronized; losing access still clears private state.
- Coalesced concurrent state reads and bursts of live updates, with a trailing
  refresh so the latest move is not lost.
- Respected rate-limit retry deadlines across polling, manual retry, live updates,
  ranking and commands. A failed move is never replayed automatically.
- Gave live game reads their own bounded budget, supporting four players and four
  spectators on one shared address without exhausting ordinary HTTP requests.
- Documented correct visitor-IP forwarding for custom Cloudflare Tunnel + Nginx
  deployments, preventing all visitors from sharing the tunnel's local-IP budget.

Authentication, voice permissions, game rules, scoring and command limits are
unchanged. No database migration is required. Restarting the application loses
ephemeral active tables; committed scores remain preserved.
